content: Khazing zingchuinah
A cang caco, Juda cawngsaw tah Gental cawngsaw navy tah chahnainah aa hmuh vypaw a ung maw? A cang ly leh cingpa a tai cawh sang a tlenah ze chang a ung maw?
A phingphing tah a hlupui a ung thlang! Ma hrong letei a hmetaw caipaw cawh Khazing tah a bia khah Juda cawngsaw a kai sahpaw he khah a cang.
Thaikhehpaw tah zingnah hnui lytah ung my he seh la zekhatamaw a cang a? Ma rawng taco Khazing zingchuinah khah zelypaw tah a cangsah a maw?
Cang hrahring be, kaa zongmingtei tah hing bia a reipaw kaa cang tahmai Khazing cawh zingawh a tlah thly thly thlang. Capathai tah,

content.text: “A reipaw bia cawh bia dih a cang tatah palang cang a ka,
sua aa ca khing tihtah na bia khah na te a,”

content: tatah a tahpaw hrakhei a cang.

Ahmang lypaw kaa tuapaw tah Khazing tei ahmangpaw hming a tuapaw khah a se vy syly tah a langsah my seh la saw, zemaw kaa rei khy a? Khazing tah kaaning khah dang a ma tah tihtah a pa maw? (Meh thaikheh tei aa reipaw khah ka reipaw a cang.)
Cang hrahring be! Khazing cawh ahmang lypaw tei a cang caco, zekhatamaw khazaw cawh bia a ce khy a?
Pakhehkheh tah, “Hing bia ka reipaw tahei Khazing zingchuipaw a cangnah le a rungnawnah a sangsah vy caco, zecawtamaw mehsua tatah thaily cangsah ka cang?” tatah bia einah a hnui khy.

“Chahnah a chua khy nápawtah chahlynah khah tua he peh,” tatah zemaw kaa tah thlang be? Ma hrahring cawh a reipaw a cang tatah mehthaikheh tah ka thaichia khah aa rei. Ma hapaw cawngsaw sahlo cawh sua phosah a tlahpaw a cang he.
Ahohmai mehding ung bei he

A cang caco zekhatamaw bia kaa pachang a? Aaning navy tah ka chah vy hlui he peh maw? Chah vy hrahring bei peh! Ka rei ciapaw hrakhei Juda cawngsaw le Gental cawngsaw a lo thlang he. Suanah rai letah a ungpaw longtei a cang he.
Capathai chung letah,

content.text: A hnihthaipaw pakheh hmai ung bei he, Khazing a huipaw ahohmai ung bei he.
Khazing a huipaw ahohmai ung bei he.
Mehnung vytei cawh lang pave thah he ka,
aa zongming teitah hmokheh tah mai hnui ly a cang he.
Chahnah a tuapaw ahohmai ung bei he,
pakheh tei hmai ung bei he.”
“Aa rong sahlo cawh kha lypaw athlai hratah cang ka,
aa lui sahlo cawh dungkheinah tah aa hmang,”
“Aa hmo sahlo taitah pari cangmai sichia a pia.”
“Aa hmokaw cawh chiasahnah le biachia biahru long teitah a chih.”
“Male thisai va chua leco a catlei ngetei he.
Aa seinahpaw langpui maikaw letah rorangnah le male lungsawnah aa va tua lai.
Denah langpui khah hnih bei he.”
“Aa mehhme letah Khazing cizawnah zong khah ung be,”

content: tatah a tahpaw hrakhei a cang.

Phungbia tei a reipaw cawh phungbia rai letei a ungpaw he aa cawtah a reipaw a cang, takhah kaa hni. Ma hratei a cangpaw cawh ming vytei tah thai aa cangnah bia zehmai rei ruapaw aa hnui ly nápaw le khazaw pungpaluh heh Khazing biacenah hme letah a daw a takhah a lang khy nápaw cawtah a cang.
Macawtaco phungbia zuinah thongtah ahohmai Khazing hme letah thai a cangsah khypaw ung bei he. Phungbia tei a reipaw cawh aa suanah hnisah khah a cang thlang.
Zingnah thongtah mehding cangnah
Canghrasala atoheh cawh phungbia thongtah cang khawh lytah Khazing dingnah cawh a langsah myca. Ma cawh phungbia le Khazing khuavang sahlo tah ahmang tatei aa tahpaw khah a cang.
Zisu Khri zingnah thongtah Khazing taitei dingnah cawh zingtu vytei cung letah a va chuh. Patliapatlanah zehmai ung be,
zecawtamaw tatah ming vytei cawh a suapaw longtei cang he peh ka, Khazing rungnawnah khah phah khy tlang bei peh.
Taico kaaning kaa suanah taitah a ma tlangtu Khri Zisu ningdonah thongtah mai lytah thai a ma cangsah.

Zisu Khri cawh Khazing tah thisai tah ngethainah a tuatu ruapaw tah a tingpaw cang ka, ma ngethainah cawh Zisu Khri zingnah thongtah hmuh ruapaw a cang. Khazing tah ma a tuapaw cawh a dingnah palangnah cawtah a cang zecawtamaw tatah alungsynah tah khahlai tei za tuapaw suanah sahlo khah dangtah lytah a seisai he.
Taico ato cai leco a dingpaw Khazing a cang zia khah a langsah ka, Zisu Khri a zingpaw maikaw khah thai a cangsah he.
A cang caco saw, kaaning ka palai ka patui khypaw peh zemaw a ung? Ung be. Zecawtamaw? Phungbia kaa zui cawtah maw? Cang be, kaa zingnah cawtah a cang.
Zecawtamaw tatah kaa tlepaw peh cawh cawngsaw cawh zingnah thongtah thai cysah a cang, phungbia zuinah thongtah cang be.
A cang ly leh Khazing cawh Juda cawngsaw aa Khazing longtei maw a cang? Gental cawngsaw sahlo aa Khazing cang hrah bei maw? A cang samaw!
Khazing cawh pakheh tei pui a cang caw, Juda cawngsaw tah aa zingnah thongtah thaicangsah cang he ka, Gental cawngsaw sahlo zong aa zingnah thong thly thly tah a cang a.
Ma hratei kaa tah tihtah hei, phungbia khah zingná tah kaa hlawh tahnah a cang maw? Cang hrahring be, phungbia tukhah kaa pacysah lui.
